primitives.name: Pricing Phase Lattice
primitives.verbatim_quote: The single source of truth for every amount is `apps/web/lib/pricing/pricing-phases.ts`.
primitives.assumptions: Each tier maps to a unique phase with fixed pricing; all prices are validated against the canonical source.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When a phase's price diverges from canonical, system fails closed.

layer2.mapping: Lattice structure of pricing phases mirrors the hierarchy of entitlements; each node represents a valid subscription tier.

primitives.name: Daily Pick Limit Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: The free daily pick allowance is owned by `packages/types/src/index.ts` (`dailyPickLimit`) — read it there rather than from prose.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{daily}}(t)': 'daily pick count at time t', 'L_{\\text{max}}': 'maximum allowed picks per day'}
primitives.assumptions: Daily limit is a bounded integer; null implies unlimited access.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Exceeding limit results in restricted access to picks.

layer2.mapping: Derived from entitlement flags; enforced via server-side access control.

primitives.name: Server-Side Enforcement
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Architecture: Server-Side Enforcement ONLY **The paywall is NEVER enforced on the client.** Premium content is filtered on the server before it reaches the client.
primitives.assumptions: Client receives only authorized content; enforcement is centralized.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Client-side bypass attempts result in unauthorized access denial.

layer2.mapping: Content flow is a morphism from client request to server response; access control is a kernel of this map.

reasoning_traces.think:
The subscription model defines a hierarchical lattice of entitlements, where each tier corresponds to a distinct valuation phase. Pricing integrity is maintained through strict validation in `pricing-phases.ts`, ensuring that Stripe prices match advertised values. A mismatch triggers a closed failure mode (503), preventing undercharging. Daily pick limits are enforced as bounded constraints, with null indicating unlimited access. Server-side filtering ensures that clients receive only content they are entitled to, enforcing a strict separation between client and server logic. This architecture supports a robust, tamper-proof subscription lifecycle with deterministic state transitions.
